style.styleTitle: Personalised Penguin Wooden Bauble by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: Add a fun and festive touch to your Christmas tree with this personalised penguin wooden bauble. Featuring a charming penguin design, this wooden decoration is perfect for creating a cosy seasonal feel in your home and makes a delightful addition to your Christmas décor. Personalise this bauble with a name of up to 12 characters, making it a thoughtful personalised Christmas gift for family, friends or loved ones. Ideal for hanging on the Christmas tree or displaying around the home, this keepsake decoration can be enjoyed year after year. Please double-check your personalisation, as your text will appear exactly as entered. This decoration comes supplied with a ribbon ready to hang straight onto the tree. The colour of ribbon may vary. Dimensions(mm): Height: 100 Width: 107 Depth: 6.
